prompt: 我们每次修改 prompt 都是直接改代码然后部署，没有测试环节。上周有人改了一行 prompt 导致回答质量断崖式下降，但过了 3 天才被发现。需要搭建一个 prompt 的 CI/CD 流水线，确保每次修改都经过测试。

assertions.description: Includes GitHub Actions (or equivalent) CI pipeline configuration
Uses path-scoped triggers (only prompt file changes trigger eval, not all commits)
Defines quality gate that blocks merge if eval scores drop below threshold
Includes staging environment before production deployment
Defines automated rollback mechanism for failed deployments
